name: watchtower-weekly
description: Assertions for the Watchtower weekly run (Knox, steps 01-05). Uses hook-implemented check types only — previous version used a custom schema the hooks never read (noted in schema.md sentinel-file section). Covers the three failure modes observed in W35 and W36: delta-check skip, dashboard artifact skip, and state not reaching complete.

assertions.description: state.yaml must reach status: complete — catches any run that aborted before step-05 closed state
Weekly note step file must exist and be written
step-05 frontmatter must record artifact_updated: true — the single most-violated assertion (err-20260831T215941-S03HMB, err-20260716T133503-XFSPE2). A false here means the dashboard was skipped.
step-01 frontmatter must record delta_check_applied: true — required by step-01 SUCCESS METRICS
step-02 must record at least one draft created — catches zero-draft runs
step-03 must record proposed_count — confirms the source-suggestion step ran
state.yaml session-id must follow the wt-weekly-YYYY-Www pattern — catches copy-paste errors and missing session writes
step-05 must surface at least one theme — zero themes with no reason noted is a synthesis failure
sources.yaml must contain at least one active source — catches accidental truncation of the registry

step-05 frontmatter must record pending_batches — proves Knox read proposed-sources.md live rather than relying on stale context. Absence means the source-approval audit step was skipped (the failure mode that caused incorrect 'Batches 7, 8, 9 pending' banners in W35 and W36).

Soft guard: flags if step-05 claims 3+ pending batches simultaneously — historically this has only occurred when Knox used stale context instead of reading proposed-sources.md. Not a hard failure (3 batches could legitimately be pending), but should be investigated.
